plans_description: A place to learn at your own pace and pick up where you left off.
new_material_version_confirm: Another version of this unit will be requested using the session's AI selection. Existing material and attempts are kept. This action reserves a new generation.
material_version_context_changed: The session changed. Close this confirmation and review the material before requesting another version.
new_session_description: Tell us what you want to learn and review the AI selection. Create plan saves your session and requests a proposal you can review before accepting it.
setup_draft_failed: Saving was not confirmed. We kept your text; check the receipt if the result is uncertain.
setup_draft_conflict: Another version is saved. Review the remote text before saving your changes.
draft_revision_conflict: Another tab changed the message draft.
create_description: Tell us what you want to learn. Saving a draft does not generate content.
invalid_field: Check this field and its limits.
empty_title: Your next learning journey starts here
empty_description: Create a session about any topic and build a plan you can return to.
configuration_notice: Configuration does not prove availability. Teacher checks this exact selection for generation without tools.
selection_missing: The saved selection is missing from the current configuration. Choose another explicitly.
no_connections: No connections are available for Teacher. You can keep your draft.
selection_unqualified: This selection is not yet available for Teacher.

reasons.adapter_unqualified: The adapter needs a current verification for this selection.
reasons.configuration_changed: The configuration changed; check it again.
reasons.qualification_required: A real Teacher inference with this selection has not been verified.
reasons.selection_unqualified: This exact selection still needs qualification.

uncertain_request: The response did not confirm the result. We kept the original intent; check its receipt without sending it again.
review_description: Review objectives, units and organization. Manual edits do not consume an inference.
invalid_plan: The plan structure needs corrections. Your changes are preserved.
final_policy: The final covers every section objective. A score of 90% or above passes, without rounding; practice has no such threshold.
unsaved_plan: There are local changes. Save them as a new revision before creating the plan.
final_no_feedback: You can review your answers. Corrections appear after submitting the complete assessment.
preparation_progress: Preparation in progress; no percentage available
job_last_known_state: We could not refresh the status. The last confirmed status is kept.
job_no_confirmed_state: There is no confirmed status for this job yet.
job_error_provider_unknown: The provider's result could not be confirmed. Check the original job; it will not be resent automatically.
job_error_result_lost: The provider finished, but a publishable result could not be recovered.
job_error_closure_unproven: Local closure of the original job has not been confirmed yet.
job_error_worker_lost: The worker stopped before the inference was sent.
job_error_preflight: Preparation could not start with this AI selection.
job_error_timeout: Local execution ran out of time. Check the original status; it will not be resent automatically.
job_error_native_excluded: The engine did not start this preparation. No content was generated.
job_error_native_excluded_retry: You can request a new preparation when available.
job_error_unrecognized: There is no recognized error detail to display. Check the job's status.
unknown_notice: This inference will not be sent again. Local closure and the remote outcome are separate states.
generation_blocked: No new content was published. Your plan and previous results are preserved.
paused_notice: Your pause was saved. Resuming restores your position; held jobs need their own explicit action to continue.
budget: Reserved generations: {{used}} of this session's limit of {{limit}}. Each request generates only the indicated resource.
define_plan: Define your plan with Nodia Teacher
setup_save_help: Keeps the draft without sending it to AI. It is also saved after you stop typing.
setup_send_help: Sends your text to AI to discuss and clarify what you need. It saves the draft for you before sending.
setup_propose_help: Implement plan requests a proposal using your goal and the conversation you sent. You can review it and request changes before accepting it to create the plan. If text remains in the editor, send or clear it before continuing.
setup_unsent_notice: This message is a draft. Send it to Teacher if you want it included in the plan.
chat_empty: Clarify your objective or ask for organization recommendations here.
choose_unit: Choose a unit to study or a section to assess directly. Material is prepared at your request.

material.not_prepared: Not prepared yet. Your plan is already saved.
material.preparing: Preparation is in progress. Check the same job.
material.unknown: The result needs reconciliation; it will not be sent again.

save_before_navigation: Save your draft before changing questions. Pausing also saves it together with your current position.

results.not_independent: Assisted practice: does not verify the section

reinforcement_notice: Review your answers and explanations to strengthen gaps. Another final will use variants covering the whole section; each attempt keeps its own score.
close_pending: Close pending grading without assigning a score
invalid_input: The data does not meet the contract. Check the fields.
incomplete_assessment: Answer every question or choose I don't know before submitting.
not_found: The resource does not exist or you do not have access.
revision_conflict: Another tab changed this resource. Your local changes are preserved; check the current state before continuing.
idempotency_conflict: This request identity already belongs to another operation.
proposal_obsolete: The proposal is based on an earlier revision. Compare its changes before applying it.
final_requires_full_submit: Final corrections appear after submitting the complete assessment.
response_already_submitted: This answer was already submitted and cannot accept another draft.
job_not_resumable: This job cannot be continued or sent again.
configuration_changed: The selection configuration changed. Check it again.
session_paused: The session is paused. Resume it before this action.
session_archived: The session is archived. Restore it before this action.
assessment_unavailable: No suitable assessment is available for this intent.
budget_exhausted: This session's generation limit was reached.
capacity_unavailable: Shared capacity is occupied. Check the job status.
adapter_unqualified: This selection is not qualified for Teacher.
provider_unavailable: The provider is unavailable for this selection.
invalid_generated_content: The received content failed validation and was not published.
session_limit: The permitted session limit was reached.
message_limit: This session's setup message limit was reached.
plan_exists: The session already has a plan. Future changes require a new revision.
question_not_current: This practice question is not available yet.
attempt_not_editable: This attempt no longer allows answer edits.
attempt_active: There is already an active attempt for this destination.
grading_not_pending: The attempt has no pending grading that can be closed.
help_unavailable: No reviewed hint is available for this question.
local_closure_required: Local closure of the original job must be verified first.
invalid_assessment: The assessment does not meet the required coverage and conditions.
assisted_final_notice: Continue as assisted practice; this assessment will not verify the section.
candidate_notice: Teacher prepared a candidate. Compare its structure with the source proposal before using it.
feedback_pending: The answer was submitted and its grading is still pending. No final score is confirmed while required grading is incomplete.
save_failed: Saving was not confirmed. Your draft is preserved; check the receipt if the result is uncertain or explicitly save after reviewing the error.
answer_conflict: Another revision changed the saved answer: {{answer}}. Your local text is preserved; compare before explicitly saving it.
request_failed: The request could not be completed. Pending changes are preserved.
session_expired: Your access session expired. Sign in to recover confirmed changes.
module_access_required: You need access to the Nodia Teacher module to continue.
authority_changed: Access changed during the operation. Content will not be published without current authority.
job_deadline: The job reached its deadline. Check its state without resending the inference.
queue_deadline: The queue deadline ended without a new inference.
dispatch_already_started: Dispatch was already armed. Check the original job without sending it again.
assessment_limits: Practice and diagnostic: 3–12 questions. Final: 10–24 questions. At least one per format and two per objective in the final. These are Teacher limits, not provider quotas. At most 8 short answers per assessment.
assessment_counts_invalid: Check the counts: positive integers, every format and objective coverage. Your values are preserved and will not be sent until corrected.
assessment_rubric: Short answers are assessed for objective (addressing the request), accuracy (correct content) and clarity (a comprehensible explanation). Specific criteria are fixed before answering; solutions and private anchors are not shown here.
reinforcement_history: This result belongs to an earlier plan version. Its objectives and units are historical; they do not redirect to the current plan.
reinforcement_open_failed: The unit could not be opened. Your result is still available. If saving is uncertain, recover the request before trying again. You can also reload to resume the last confirmed point.
reinforcement_unavailable: No targeted units are available for this result. Review the feedback or choose a unit from the current plan.
reinforcement_choose_unit: Choose a unit from the current plan
setup_autosave_help: Your message is saved automatically after you stop typing. Saving does not send it to AI.
message_placeholder: Talk with Teacher about what you want to learn…
confirm_proposal_message: Teacher will prepare a proposal using your goal and the conversation sent up to here. You can review it, keep chatting and request changes before accepting it to create the plan. This action does not start the course yet.
proposal_context_changed: The session or conversation changed. Return to the chat, review the changes and open the proposal again.
code_copy_manual: Select the code and copy it manually.
